title: Bubbles agent RESULT-ENVELOPE (machine-readable, v5.1 / M3)
description: Structured form of the markdown RESULT-ENVELOPE every Bubbles agent emits. Workflow agent parses the JSON instead of grepping prose. Markdown envelope MUST still be emitted alongside for human readability — JSON envelope is additive, not a replacement.

spec.description: Spec slug (e.g. '042-foo'). Empty for framework-level invocations.

outcome.description: One of the four canonical outcomes from Gate G063 (concrete_result_gate).

learning.description: IMP-043 SCOPE-1. Records the lesson decision made at result-envelope close. The object is OPTIONAL, so no existing envelope becomes invalid; when present it must be a decision rather than a gesture. This is deliberately NOT a per-run lesson quota: execution-ops.md argues that forcing one lesson per run manufactures filler and degrades clustering, and that reasoning is preserved. What is recorded is that the decision was MADE.

disposition.description: captured = a lesson was written and lessonId names it. not-applicable = the run produced nothing generalizable. deferred = a lesson is owed and reason says why it was not written now.

lessonId.description: Identifier of the written lesson. Required when disposition is `captured`.

reason.description: Why capture was deferred. Required when disposition is `deferred`. The length floor exists because 'later' is not a reason.

reviewCompliance.description: IMP-048 SCOPE-1. Names which active Class A in-session adjustments this run honored, and why any did not apply. The array is OPTIONAL, so no existing envelope becomes invalid; when present it turns an adjustment from a note the parent wrote into something the child is accountable for. An adjustment reported as not honored twice becomes an automatic Class B improvement candidate in `.specify/runtime/session-review.jsonl`.

adjustment.description: The Class A `change` identifier carried in the dispatch packet's activeAdjustments[].

honored.description: Whether this run actually followed the adjustment.

reason.description: Why the adjustment did not apply. Required when `honored` is false, because 'did not apply' with no reason is indistinguishable from having ignored it.

evidenceRefs.description: References to evidence: report.md anchors, tool-log session ids, file paths, commit SHAs.

owner.description: Agent name responsible for closing this finding.

goalImpact.description: What this finding means for the requested outcome (IMP-038 SCOPE-4 / GF-3). ORTHOGONAL to the G095 disposition, which records what was filed. `required`: inside the work boundary and the Goal Contract cannot be satisfied while it is open - complete the finding-owned planning and delivery chain. `blocking-external`: outside the boundary but it prevents the success signal or violates a hard constraint - BLOCK the parent. `independent`: affects neither the success signal nor any hard constraint - discharge via its G095 disposition under a separate packet and continue. An `independent` claim that cannot be demonstrated at final validation is `blocking-external`.

disposition.description: The Gate G095 disposition. Unchanged closed set; recorded alongside goalImpact.

filedArtifact.description: Path to the artifact that discharges the disposition, on disk as of this turn. Required for a `routed` or `independent` finding: an `independent` finding with no filed artifact is NOT discharged.

addressedFindings.description: IDs from a prior packet's findings[] that this invocation closed.

unresolvedFindings.description: IDs from a prior packet's findings[] that this invocation could not close. MUST be empty when outcome=completed_owned.

nextOwner.description: Required when outcome=route_required (preferred field name). Agent name expected to act next. May be aliased as nextRequiredOwner for backwards compatibility. null is permitted for non-routing outcomes.

nextRequiredOwner.description: Legacy alias for nextOwner. Either field satisfies the outcome=route_required requirement; new agents SHOULD prefer nextOwner.

blocker.description: Required when outcome=blocked. Describes concretely what prevents progress.

continuation.description: Optional continuation envelope for advisory/read-only surfaces.

toolCalls.description: Session ids from tool-calls.jsonl that prove this invocation's claims. Read by v5.2 evidence gate.

repositoryRoot.description: Canonical absolute root for a local actionable result, or <redacted-local-root> for a public non-actionable projection.

repositoryResolution.description: Repository decision provenance echoed by an actionable result.

goalRef.description: Goal identity echoed by a specialist result (IMP-038 SCOPE-3 / GF-1, GF-5). Present whenever the run froze a Goal Contract. Verified with `goal-contract.sh verify-ref`, which refuses an omitted field, a substituted goalId/revision/digest, and a workBoundary wider than the frozen contract's.

boundaryReceiptDigest.description: The receiptDigest of the G134 boundary receipt that authorised this transition (IMP-041 SCOPE-3 / GF-7). Minted only by `goal-boundary-receipt.sh emit`, which prints nothing when the boundary fails — so carrying a valid digest is evidence the check RAN, not merely that a runner claimed it did. A parent verifies it with `goal-boundary-receipt.sh verify --expect-boundary <name>`, which refuses a receipt that is stale, edited, or minted for a different boundary.
